use_rank0_only: use the rank0_only decorator to run a function only on world rank 0
init_distrib_slurm: initialize torch distributed process group using SLURM environment variables and a TCP store
gatherv_tensors: gather variable-size 1D tensors from all ranks into a single rank using gatherv
gather_objects_across_ranks: gather arbitrary Python objects from all distributed ranks to one output rank using gather_objects
save_and_load_resume_state: save and load preemption resume state to disk for SLURM job recovery
